# 502 Tinted

> 502 Tinted is a window tint and auto detailing shop in Valley Station, Louisville, Kentucky, owned and run by Shane Crosier. It is a HITEK dealer installing HITEK Ceramic IR and Ceramic Plus window film, plus windshield sun strips and windshield heat film, tint removal, interior and exterior detailing and paint correction.

Key facts:
- Address: 5410 Valley Station Rd #108, Louisville, KY 40272 (Valley Station, southwest Louisville, near Dixie Highway and the Gene Snyder Freeway)
- Phone and text: (502) 631-0419; email 502tinted@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 9 AM–3 PM; Wednesday 10 AM–5 PM; Saturday 8 AM–1 PM; closed Sunday
- Google rating: 5.0 stars from 30 reviews (October 2026)
- Window tint: HITEK Ceramic IR from $249 and HITEK Ceramic Plus from $349 for a car's side windows and back glass; front two doors from $129; lifetime film warranty
- Detailing: maintenance wash from $59, interior detail from $149, exterior detail from $129, full detail from $229, paint correction from $399
- Kentucky tint law summary: front side windows at least 35% light transmission; windows behind the driver at least 18% (8% on multipurpose passenger vehicles such as most SUVs and vans); film is rated on clear glass with a 3% tolerance; reflectance up to 25% front and 35% rear; windshield film only as a top strip above the AS-1 line or a clear film that keeps the windshield at 70% or more; installers must put a compliance label on the inside of the driver's door jamb.
- Service area: Louisville (Valley Station, Pleasure Ridge Park, Shively, Fairdale, Okolona, St. Matthews, Jeffersontown), Bullitt County (Hillview, Shepherdsville, Mount Washington) and Hardin County (Radcliff, Fort Knox, Elizabethtown)
- Quote request: https://www.502tinted.com/get-a-quote
